title: 第17章 代练第18章 生财有道
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
“苟系统！
接下来怎么做？”
陆沉看着陆凯之送来的一大堆药材，不禁有些头疼：“当时说越多越好，但面前这量少说也有一百多份吧，这得炼到什么时候啊。”
9527则是一脸看热闹不嫌事大的样子：“淡定！
很容易搞定的！”
陆沉满脸的不可置信：“真的假的？”
“本统子什么时候骗过你？”
陆沉闻言面色阴沉地指了指苟系统手中的《昆仑神女大战天山童姥》。
9527翻了翻白眼，干咳一声：“咳咳，除了那次，我没骗过你吧！”
“应该是吧。”
陆沉眯着眼看着苟系统。
9527连忙缓解尴尬：“好啦，说正事，虽然过程很容易，但对元力消耗可不小哦！
你要做好心理准备。”
陆沉闻言立马暴怒：“你这不是扯淡吗？我才开蒙境一重，拿头炼啊？”
苟系统连忙摆手：“别着急嘛！
本统子自然有办法。”
说着从系统仓库里取出之前陆沉开盲盒得到的黑炎晶：“用它就好了，本来它的元力你直接吸收还需要消化一段时间，但刚好它是火属性的元力，拿来炼丹正合适，到时候你就直接吸收，然后直接用来炼丹，这样不仅稳固了经脉，还能提升你的修为，也能得到丹药，一箭三雕！”
“这样行得通吗？”
9527一脸傲娇地说道：“不要怀疑本统子啊！
不过这个过程是本统子控制你的身体进行，等换回来，你可能需要重新适应一下自己的修为，另外还会有点疼哦！”

“疼倒是无所谓啦！
不过我突然想到一个问题，我是不是该准备个药鼎丹炉什么的？”
“你是不是忘了你还有个好东西来着？”
说着，9527把在仓库里放了六年的神秘黑鼎取了出来，那黑鼎“轰”
的一声落在地上，三条腿立在那里稳如泰山。
陆沉目瞪口呆地望着这个都快被他遗忘的黑鼎，一脸嫌弃：“这个不是熬汤用的吗？而且它也没有盖子啊！”
9527翻了翻白眼说道：“行不行你试试看咯！”
“要怎么做？”
“左手握着黑炎晶，试着吸收一点元力，然后让元力流过经脉，用右手形成火焰加热这个鼎。”
“哦！”
陆沉应了一声，左手拿起那块巴掌大的黑色晶石，一股温热感迅速袭来，然后他又试着引导黑炎晶里的元力流入自己体内，一开始没有分寸，吸收的有点多，身体立刻传来剧烈的灼烧感，疼的陆沉差点把那黑炎晶丢在地上。
9527在一旁提醒道：“都说了，一点，慢慢来！”
陆沉重新调整了状态，这次试着只吸取了一点点元力，果然没有之前的疼痛感了，取而代之的是一股席卷全身的暖流。
“引导它在你全身的经脉里走一遍！”
陆沉闻言照做，只觉得那股元力流过全身，整个身体都无比舒畅起来，自身的经脉也得到了滋养变得更强健了。
“不要忙着消化它，它不是你的，消化起来太费时间了，引导它到你的右手，慢点放出来去烧那个鼎。”
陆沉只好放弃了消化那些元力的想法，将全身的元力汇聚到右手，然后缓缓释放出来，只见一道巴掌大的火苗出现在他手心里。
陆沉连忙把火苗对准了那黑鼎，只见那黑鼎内的温度很快便升了起来。
9527在一旁看着，露出一副果然如此的表情，心里想到：“这鼎这么厚，热量传递的还这么快，而且完全没有见热量溢出来，果然是个宝贝。
content_en:
"Gou System!
What to do next? "
Lu Chen looked at the large pile of medicinal materials sent by Lu Kaizhi and couldn't help but feel a little headache: "At the time, I said the more the better, but the quantity in front of me is probably more than a hundred copies. How long will it take to refine it?"
9527, on the other hand, looked like he was just watching the fun and not taking the matter seriously: "Calm down!
It's easy to do! "
Lu Chen's face was full of disbelief: "Real or false?"
"When did Ben Tongzi lie to you?"
When Lu Chen heard this, he pointed with a gloomy expression to the "Kunlun Goddess vs. Tianshan Child Elder" in Gou System's hand.
9527 rolled his eyes and coughed dryly: "Ahem, apart from that time, I have never lied to you!"
"Probably so."
Lu Chen squinted at Gou System.
9527 quickly relieved the embarrassment: "Okay, let's get down to business. Although the process is easy, it consumes a lot of energy!
You have to be mentally prepared. "
When Lu Chen heard this, he immediately became furious: "Aren't you talking nonsense? I've only just opened the first level of Meng Realm, how about practicing with my head?"
Gou System quickly waved his hand: "Don't worry!
Ben Tongzi naturally has a way. "
As he spoke, he took out the black flame crystal that Lu Chen had obtained from opening the blind box before from the system warehouse: "Just use it. Originally, you need to digest its elemental power for a while to directly absorb it, but it happens to be a fire-attributed elemental power, so it is just right to use it to make elixirs. When the time comes, you can absorb it directly and then use it directly to make elixirs. This will not only stabilize the meridians, but also improve your cultivation. You can also get elixirs, killing three birds with one stone!"
"Would this work?"
9527 said with an arrogant look: "Don't doubt Ben Tongzi!
However, this process is carried out by Ben Tongzi controlling your body. When it comes back, you may need to adapt to your own cultivation level again, and it will also hurt a little! "
“It doesn’t matter if it hurts!
But a question suddenly occurred to me, should I prepare a medicine cauldron or something? "
"Did you forget that you still have something good?"
As he said that, 9527 took out the mysterious black cauldron that had been in the warehouse for six years. The black cauldron "boomed"
It fell to the ground with a thud, and its three legs stood there as steady as a mountain.
Lu Chen stared blankly at the black cauldron that he had almost forgotten, with a look of disgust on his face: "Isn't this for making soup? And it doesn't have a lid!"
9527 rolled his eyes and said, "Okay, please give it a try!"
"What to do?"
"Holding the black flame crystal in your left hand, try to absorb a little bit of Yuan Power, then let the Yuan Power flow through the meridians, and use your right hand to form a flame to heat the cauldron."
"Oh!"
Lu Chen responded and picked up the palm-sized black crystal with his left hand. A warm feeling quickly hit him. Then he tried to guide the energy in the black flame crystal to flow into his body. He was not careful at first and absorbed a little too much. His body immediately felt a severe burning sensation. Lu Chen almost dropped the black flame crystal in pain.
9527 reminded from the side: "I said it all, just take it slow!"
Lu Chen readjusted his condition, and this time he tried to absorb only a little bit of energy. As expected, there was no pain like before, and instead there was a warm current that swept through his body.
"Guide it to go through the meridians throughout your body!"
Lu Chen heard the instructions and did as he was told, feeling the energy flowing through his body. His whole body felt extremely comfortable, and his own meridians were nourished and became stronger.
"Don't be too busy digesting it. It's not yours. It takes too much time to digest. Guide it to your right hand and release it slowly to burn the cauldron."
Lu Chen had no choice but to give up the idea of digesting those Yuan Power, gathered all the Yuan Power in his right hand, and then slowly released it, only to see a palm-sized flame appear in his palm.
Lu Chen quickly pointed the flame at the black cauldron, and saw that the temperature inside the black cauldron quickly rose.
9527 watched from the side with an expression that was indeed true, thinking in his heart: "This cauldron is so thick and hot.The amount is transferred so quickly, and there is no heat leakage at all. It is indeed a treasure.
